Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Noal McDonald writes:
> If I block an action with an untapped vampire and use
> Obedience, is my vampire still tapped?

?

"still" implies that he was tapped to begin with, and your
question starts by asserting otherwise.

Your vampire remains untapped.

--
